covariance_falsifier.threshold: declared projection w' V w plus eps2 + D eps1, with D = sum_k |w_k| (max score - min score), s = sqrt(ln(4 / t) / (2 n)), eps1 = D s, eps2 = (D^2 / 4) s, n the PUB's shots and t = tail / number of declared bounds
